meta.authority: Product Governance Board (founder ratification pending on Needs Discussion + REC-*)

existing_gov_references.note: Destructive confirm; branded elevated in GOV-065

decisions.title: Interaction must justify fidelity, speed, trust, or clarity
decisions.decision: Every interaction must justify at least one of: fidelity, speed, trust, or clarity. Interactions that add ceremony without one of these are non-canon.
decisions.reason: Non-Negotiables Required 2 — extends feature intake to interaction-level economy.

evidence.quote: Every interaction justifies fidelity, speed, trust, or clarity.

decisions.implementation_impact: UX reviews reject taps/screens that cannot name which of the four they serve.

decisions.title: Every animation must communicate meaning
decisions.decision: Every animation must communicate meaning. Decorative motion without semantic or emotional-contract purpose is forbidden.

evidence.quote: Every animation communicates meaning.

decisions.implementation_impact: Motion PRs must state what meaning the motion communicates; else remove.

decisions.title: Every notification must deserve attention
decisions.decision: Every notification must deserve attention. Notifications that do not clear an attention-worthiness bar are forbidden.
decisions.reason: Non-Negotiables Required 4; fills Constitution M-010 partially (taxonomy still missing).

evidence.quote: Every notification deserves attention.

decisions.implementation_impact: Needs founder-approved notification taxonomy (channels, urgency, mute rules) before full enforcement. Until then: reject obviously low-value pushes.

decisions.title: Branded destructive confirm; ban window.confirm
decisions.decision: Every destructive action must confirm with a branded confirm path. Product destructive paths must not use browser/native generic window.confirm.
decisions.reason: Non-Negotiables Required 5 (branded) + Forbidden 28; elevates Constitution CF-002.

evidence.quote: Every destructive action confirms (branded).
No `window.confirm` for product destructive paths.

decisions.implementation_impact: Ship shared branded confirm pattern on web + Android; grep-ban window.confirm in product flows.

decisions.title: Ceremony-free Enter/primary save on every capture path
decisions.decision: Every capture path must allow Enter or primary save without ceremony (no forced taxonomy, mode gates, or extra steps before save).

evidence.quote: Every capture path allows Enter/primary save without ceremony.

decisions.implementation_impact: Capture flows must expose primary save/Enter first; structure optional after.

decisions.title: Every empty state must teach
decisions.decision: Every empty state must teach — orient the user to the next useful action or meaning of the surface. Blank decorative emptiness is forbidden.

evidence.quote: Every empty state teaches.

decisions.implementation_impact: Empty states require teaching copy/CTA; shame-empty and dead blank panels are non-canon.

decisions.title: Life Score honest; XP celebratory — roles unmixed
decisions.decision: Life Score stays honest; XP stays celebratory. Their roles must not be mixed (no vanity Life Score; no dishonest XP-as-health).

evidence.quote: Life Score stays honest; XP stays celebratory — roles unmixed.

decisions.implementation_impact: Needs Life Score formula/inputs (Constitution M-005) plus explicit XP role matrix before full enforcement.

decisions.title: Secrets never enter vault, docs, or commit chat dumps
decisions.decision: Secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords, connection strings) must never enter vault notes, docs, or chat dumps intended for commit. Env names OK; values stay in host secrets / local .env.

evidence.quote: Secrets never enter vault/docs/chat dumps for commit.

decisions.implementation_impact: Pre-commit and agent rules scrub secrets; vault review rejects secret values.

decisions.title: Meds/allergies/PIN never inferred; PIN never in telemetry
decisions.decision: Medications, allergies, and PIN must never be inferred by AI or automation. PIN must never appear in telemetry.
decisions.reason: Non-Negotiables Required 21 + Forbidden 24; fills Constitution M-016.

evidence.quote: Meds/allergies/PIN never inferred.
No PIN in telemetry.

decisions.implementation_impact: Hard deny-list in inference + telemetry scrubbers; explicit user entry only for these fields.

decisions.title: Critical-path contrast and operable capture
decisions.decision: Accessibility contrasts and operable capture are required on critical paths.
decisions.reason: Non-Negotiables Required 22; WCAG level still deferred to Accessibility Principles (M-008).

evidence.quote: Accessibility contrasts and operable capture on critical paths.

decisions.implementation_impact: Needs WCAG target + contrast tokens from Accessibility Principles; until then enforce operable capture + no color-only status (GOV-087).

decisions.title: Reduced motion must be honored
decisions.decision: Reduced motion preferences must be honored across product surfaces.
decisions.reason: Non-Negotiables Required 23; durations/easing still in Motion Principles (M-009).

evidence.quote: Reduced motion honored.

decisions.implementation_impact: Respect OS/prefers-reduced-motion; provide non-animated equivalents for meaning-bearing motion.

decisions.title: Cross-client token meaning aligned; drift is debt
decisions.decision: Cross-client token meaning must stay aligned. Treating conflicting token sources as options is forbidden — drift is debt.

evidence.quote: Cross-client token meaning stays aligned.
No treating conflicting token sources as "options" — drift is debt.

decisions.implementation_impact: Founder must name single token source of truth and audit web/Android/native drift.

decisions.title: Kill List consulted before new fields
decisions.decision: The Kill List must be consulted before adding new fields. Fields that revive killed concepts are forbidden without founder override.

evidence.quote: Kill List consulted before new fields.

decisions.implementation_impact: Field/feature proposals must cite Kill List check; PR template checkbox.

decisions.title: No duplicate navigation systems fighting for primacy
decisions.decision: There must not be duplicate navigation systems fighting for primacy.
decisions.reason: Non-Negotiables Forbidden 1; nav destinations still missing (M-001 / IA Principles).

evidence.quote: No duplicate navigation systems fighting for primacy.

decisions.implementation_impact: Needs IA Principles + primary nav map; until then reject second competing nav shells.

decisions.title: Today anti-clutter: no meaningless widgets; no DEMO/LIVE vanity chrome
decisions.decision: Today must not host meaningless widgets. DEMO/LIVE vanity chrome must not compete with Capture on Today.

evidence.quote: No meaningless widgets on Today.
No DEMO/LIVE vanity chrome competing with Capture on Today.

decisions.implementation_impact: Today modules must justify capture/clarity value; strip vanity status chrome.

decisions.title: No interaction without feedback
decisions.decision: No interaction without feedback. User-initiated actions must produce perceptible confirmation, progress, or error state.

evidence.quote: No interaction without feedback.

decisions.implementation_impact: Buttons/gestures/sync actions need feedback states; silent no-ops forbidden.

decisions.title: No automatic posting of private life
decisions.decision: Automatic posting of private life is forbidden.

evidence.quote: No automatic posting of private life.

decisions.implementation_impact: Any share/publish path requires explicit user action; no silent auto-post.

decisions.title: No dark-pattern upgrade nags; no infinite customization onboarding
decisions.decision: Dark-pattern upgrade nags are forbidden. Infinite customization onboarding is forbidden.

evidence.quote: No dark-pattern upgrade nags.
No infinite customization onboarding.

decisions.implementation_impact: Upgrade prompts honest + dismissible; onboarding finite and capture-first.

decisions.title: Anti-picker proliferation: mood, theme, Life Arc
decisions.decision: Forbidden: a fifth mood picker family; a third theme picker family (prefer OS sync); parallel Life Arc editors.

evidence.quote: No fifth mood picker family.
No third theme picker family (prefer OS sync).
No parallel Life Arc editors.

decisions.implementation_impact: Reuse existing pickers/editors; theme prefers OS; no parallel Life Arc write UIs.

decisions.title: Dead accent revival ban: electric blue; Waitlist forest-green as Life OS
decisions.decision: Electric blue system accent revival is forbidden. Forest-green WaitlistBrand-as-Life-OS identity is forbidden.

evidence.quote: No electric blue system accent revival.
No forest-green WaitlistBrand-as-Life-OS.

decisions.implementation_impact: Keep WaitlistBrand scoped to waitlist surfaces; Life OS uses locked palette only.

decisions.title: No invented finance transactions without utterance
decisions.decision: Finance transactions must not be invented without an utterance (or equivalent explicit user capture).

evidence.quote: No invented finance transactions without utterance.

decisions.implementation_impact: Finance write path requires user utterance/explicit capture; AI may suggest with correction chip only.

decisions.title: Journal body never in push notifications
decisions.decision: Journal body must never appear in push notifications.
decisions.reason: Non-Negotiables Forbidden 23; extends GOV-016 beyond analytics.

evidence.quote: No journal body in push notifications.

decisions.implementation_impact: Push templates use generic/safe titles only; never journal body text.

decisions.title: Elite is not longer-PDF product definition
decisions.decision: Elite-as-longer-PDF must not define the product or tier value.

evidence.quote: No Elite-as-longer-PDF as the product definition.

decisions.implementation_impact: Tier differentiation must be capability/outcome based, not PDF length.

decisions.title: Capacitor not primary app; native not bound by /m capture ceiling
decisions.decision: Capacitor-as-primary-app revival against founder decision is forbidden. The phone-web /m capture-only ceiling must not be applied as the native app's destiny.
decisions.reason: Non-Negotiables Forbidden 31–32; reinforces Constitution CF-006 resolution.

evidence.quote: No Capacitor-as-primary-app revival against founder decision.
No "capture-only" ceiling applied as the native app's destiny.

decisions.implementation_impact: Native Android is rich companion; Capacitor /m remains capture stopgap only.

decisions.title: Agent memory hygiene: vault over whole-repo scan; slim AGENTS; no vendor vanity
decisions.decision: Whole-repo scan culture replacing vault Brain OS is forbidden. Fat AGENTS.md dump revival is forbidden. Vendor attribution vanity in product docs/commits is forbidden.

evidence.quote: No whole-repo scan culture replacing vault Brain OS for agents.
No fat AGENTS.md dump revival.
No vendor attribution vanity in product docs/commits.

decisions.implementation_impact: Agents load Home → Current Context → relevant vault notes; keep AGENTS.md slim pointer.

decisions.title: No emoji-as-IA; no color-only critical status
decisions.decision: Emoji must not serve as information architecture. Critical status must not be color-only.

evidence.quote: No emoji-as-IA.
No color-only critical status.

decisions.implementation_impact: IA uses text/structure; status uses text/icon + color, never color alone.

decisions.title: No mid-Focus coaching modals
decisions.decision: Mid-Focus coaching modals are forbidden.

evidence.quote: No mid-Focus coaching modals.

decisions.implementation_impact: Defer coaching until Focus session ends or user opens coaching surface.

decisions.title: No silent failed sync presented as success
decisions.decision: Silent failed sync must never be presented as success.

evidence.quote: No silent failed sync presented as success.

decisions.implementation_impact: Failed/pending sync must surface truthful state; success chrome only on confirmed success.

decisions.title: No Inter-as-brand-identity; no unemployed font buffet
decisions.decision: Inter-as-brand-identity and unemployed font buffet on product surfaces are forbidden.

evidence.quote: No Inter-as-brand-identity or unemployed font buffet on product surfaces.

decisions.implementation_impact: Use locked brand typography; do not default Inter as identity or scatter unused font families.

decisions.title: No identical glass-card grids as only page personality
decisions.decision: Identical glass-card grids must not be the only page personality.

evidence.quote: No identical glass-card grids as the only page personality.

decisions.implementation_impact: Surfaces may use cards for interaction containers; pages need distinct composition beyond cloned glass grids.

decisions.title: No device bait-and-switch marketing vs shipped ceilings
decisions.decision: Device bait-and-switch marketing (e.g., "pocket Life OS") that contradicts shipped ceilings is forbidden.

evidence.quote: No device bait-and-switch marketing ("pocket Life OS") that contradicts shipped ceilings.

decisions.implementation_impact: Marketing must match /m vs native vs desktop ceilings actually shipped.

decisions.title: Eight gate questions mandatory beside every proposal
decisions.decision: Every proposal must be checked against the eight Non-Negotiables gate questions (Kill List, duplicate primitive, interaction inflation, device ceiling, AI chip vs ask, ten-year truth, trust pillars, Constitution conflict). Any fail means redesign or reject.

evidence.quote: Kill List conflict?
Any fail → redesign or reject.

decisions.implementation_impact: Print 8 gates on proposal/PR templates; fail = redesign or reject.

recommendations.title: Adopt Non-Negotiables eight-gate checklist on every feature/design proposal
recommendations.risk: Low process friction; High if skipped — identity drift.

recommendations.title: Publish Notification Taxonomy Spec (channels, urgency, mute, attention bar)
recommendations.reason: GOV-064 Approved intent but Needs Discussion on taxonomy; fills M-010.
recommendations.risk: High if delayed — nag culture returns.

recommendations.title: Ship branded destructive-confirm component standard; ban window.confirm in CI
Publish Life Score vs XP role matrix + formula pointer
recommendations.reason: GOV-068 Needs Discussion; Constitution M-005 open.
recommendations.impact: Prevents vanity Life Score / dishonest XP mix.
recommendations.risk: High if undefined — gamification casino drift.

recommendations.title: Name single design-token source of truth + run cross-client drift audit
recommendations.impact: Stops treating conflicting tokens as options.
recommendations.risk: Extreme cost if delayed — visual/technical debt.

recommendations.title: Wire Kill List living index into field/schema intake
Resolve navigation primacy via IA Principles pass (primary nav map)
recommendations.reason: GOV-075 Needs Discussion; M-001 still open.

recommendations.title: Engineering deny-list for meds/allergies/PIN inference + PIN telemetry scrub
recommendations.risk: High if missed — sensitive data leak/inference.

recommendations.title: Publish Sync Honesty UX contract (pending/fail/success states)
Founder confirm CF-002 closed by GOV-065 (branded confirm)
recommendations.reason: Constitution flagged incomplete confirm; NN elevates branded.
recommendations.impact: Conflict hygiene clean for destructive UX.

conflicts.detail: Constitution GOV-015/046 require destructive confirm. Non-Negotiables require branded confirm and ban window.confirm. Flagged as CF-002 in Constitution governance; elevated here as GOV-065. Do not amend Constitution.
conflicts.recommendation: REC-018 + REC-025. Founder confirm CF-002 closed.

conflicts.detail: Non-Negotiables Required 13 states brand lockup split as absolute must. Constitution GOV-012 remains Needs Discussion solely for Today≡/overview route bind (CF-001), while split behavior itself is Approved via GOV-039. Do not auto-resolve route alias.
conflicts.recommendation: Keep REC-003. Cite GOV-039 for split law; leave GOV-012 Needs Discussion until route alias ratified.

conflicts.detail: GOV-064 asserts every notification deserves attention but Non-Negotiables give no taxonomy/thresholds (Constitution M-010).
conflicts.recommendation: REC-017. Do not invent taxonomy as canon.

conflicts.detail: GOV-068 requires Life Score/XP role separation but formula/inputs still missing (Constitution M-005).
GOV-073 requires token alignment but does not name the single source of truth.
GOV-075 forbids duplicate navigation primacy fights but does not name primary destinations (M-001).
GOV-071 requires critical-path contrast but WCAG level/targets still deferred (M-008).
conflicts.recommendation: Govern 11_ACCESSIBILITY_PRINCIPLES later; until then enforce GOV-087 color-only ban.

conflicts.detail: Non-Negotiables Known risks: list may be weaponized to block Design Lab. Constitution allows sandboxed exploration; NN Tradeoffs affirm Design Lab valid. No auto-ban of Design Lab.
conflicts.recommendation: Design Lab remains sandboxed; Non-Negotiables bind shipping product, not lab experiments.

missing_decisions.missing: Life Score formula + XP role matrix
Branded confirm component API across clients

missing_decisions.why: GOV-090 forbids Inter-as-brand but does not name replacements here

missing_decisions.missing: Kill List living index path for agents

questions_for_founder: Confirm CF-002 closed by GOV-065 (branded confirm + window.confirm ban)?
Approve notification taxonomy process (REC-017) — who owns first draft?
Point to Life Score formula source for GOV-068 / REC-019.
Name the single design-token source of truth (REC-020).
Confirm Capacitor remains capture stopgap only; native rich companion (GOV-085) — any exception path?
Is Design Lab explicitly exempt from Non-Negotiables while sandboxed (CF-NN-008)?
Should GOV-093 eight gates become mandatory PR checklist immediately?
Any Non-Negotiable rule founder wants softened before Approved status sticks?
For GOV-071, interim contrast rule until Accessibility Principles governed?

score.interpretation: Non-Negotiables strongly operationalize Constitution refuse/require lists. New GOV-062…093 fill M-016 and many UX/privacy gates. Still Needs Discussion on notifications, Life Score/XP roles, token SoT, nav primacy, and WCAG targets. No hard contradiction with Constitution; additive refinements flagged.
